initialization_and_cleanup_obligations.description: Float16 and signed Q16 parameter packing are retained only as measurements because their measured maximum absolute error exceeded the frozen 1e-5 numeric tolerance.

measurements.notes: Contract-only measurement gave canonical parameter layout 595 bytes, varint/string-table 285 bytes with zero error, float16 271 bytes, and signed Q16 271 bytes. Float16/Q16 exceeded the frozen 1e-5 numeric tolerance and were rejected. The canonical layout remains selected; no tolerance was relaxed.

diagnostics.summary: Float16/Q16 packing reduced payload bytes but exceeded the frozen numeric absolute tolerance, so the alternatives were rejected.
diagnostics.preservation_statement: Rejected alternatives remain in the NW-10 evidence record with measured error and byte deltas.
